fusions.name: Sprout Shot
fusions.desc: Uses up one of your afflictions on the target to deal 9 damage, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pollen Spray
fusions.desc: Looses 3 spread-out pollen bolts that each deal 6 damage. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Kelp Bed
fusions.desc: Raises a kelp bed where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Rooted Drift
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded kelpling that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.5 seconds within 5 tiles. Each kill it makes restores 2 health to you.
